status: Complete finite validation with no unresolved severe rendered defect in tested scope
renderer: Actual AvatarRenderer geometry, vertex shader, model/projection matrices and culling replayed in native Mesa GLES3. Diagnostic fragment encodes semantic object IDs and 16-bit depth.
runtimeHistory: Renderer resets at each independent sequence; delta in seconds; actual animation and chronological warmup retained. Raw and world-space motion measured separately.

coverage.meaning: Unique keys verified within each matrix; physical states may overlap across matrices.

matrix.runtimeHistory: Independent renderer reset at each activity/camera/morph sequence. Exact selected runtime replay warms from zero. Delta is seconds.

semanticIdDisagreement.interpretation: Culled versus unculled semantic IDs differ at one or two pixels in these cases, without missing garment coverage. These tiny material-ID residuals are retained in raw metrics; they are not reported as disappearing geometry.

phases.criterion: No removed cuff/crown pixels; one garment-only crown component; every cuff pixel within2px of garment silhouette; no culling,ID,or depth discrepancy. Other cases require manual review.

extremaVisualReview.pixelTriangleTurn: Frames 135–139, both cameras: supported cap with gradual cuff relaxation; no independent pop, tear or disappearance.
extremaVisualReview.celebration: Oval/Bun frames 0–3 and PixelTriangle frames 18–22, both cameras: high mask change and world motion arise from shared body/root movement, with coherent supported garment.

reviewedMotionExceptions.assessment: Rapid but coherent supported seating/curl recovery; not an isolated reset, tear or disappearance. This case-specific assessment is not a general jump tolerance.
Bounded residual retained and disclosed. Runtime default and linear controls show no conspicuous independent pop. No claim of perfect mathematical continuity.

findings.appearanceScope: Settled wearing remains the primary quality gate. Brief intermediate openings and supported rapid relaxation are accepted; conspicuous independent jumps, tearing, disappearance and severe distortion remain failures.

baselineControls.scope: Only the exact Cookie6Sided idle425→426 and SoftBurst idle87→88 animation regressions, not global accessory aesthetic acceptance.

geometryGate.scope: Independent final-source intersection, topology and normal audit, separate from rendered case coverage.

limitations: Finite15-degree angle grid, eight selected runtime extrema, and dense30fps sampling at two cameras are not a proof over every continuous angle/time.
Native diagnostic raster replay complements browser integration tests; it does not guarantee identical antialiasing on every GPU.
An empty hat cavity is not solid cloth. Natural body occlusion and visible inner lining are separately classified; zero intersections alone does not establish convincing wearing.
Some accepted fast transitions remain visibly quick. The bounded Burst residual and case-specific recovery above are not hidden by an enlarged global threshold.
